summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement, Amendment No. 1, for a 424B5 shelf takedown of $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due November 1, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF and the S&P 500 Index. Pricing is set for October 28, 2026, with an original issue date of October 30, 2026. The notes pay a $30 quarterly contingent coupon and autocall quarterly beginning October 28, 2027. This is a routine structured-note issuance under the Series A medium-term note program, not a special situation; watch for final pricing and whether principal is upsized.
